plugins.name: sun
plugins.description: /sunrise bootstraps a new project across every layer and proves it live; /sunset archives one reversibly.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: /forge generates AI images on Fal.ai with Claude as the brain layer: writes the prompts, generates drafts, runs vision QA, and renders finished on-brand images. Model-agnostic (nano-banana / GPT Image 2 / FLUX), with a per-run cost cap and an auditable run manifest.

plugins.name: wargame
plugins.description: /wargame runs an adversarial pre-mortem on any target — new project, existing feature, or planned change — with ranked, verified failure modes and kill criteria. Opus-class models or better.

plugins.name: signoff
plugins.description: /signoff runs an independent adversarial review of freshly built work and ends in a signed verdict — SIGNED OFF / WITH CONDITIONS / REJECTED — plus a punch list. Reviewers who did not write the code check it against its spec. The back half of /wargame. Opus-class models or better.

plugins.name: arcade
plugins.description: /arcade publishes and manages pages on the Line 7 Arcade (arcade.line7.works) from any repo — publish, update, list, reorder, feature, and delete via the bundled arcade-publish CLI. Writes to live production; delete is gated behind an explicit conversational yes.

plugins.name: inspect
plugins.description: /inspect plan-checks a /blueprint build doc BEFORE /build runs it — traceability, code-book, and repo-reality lenses, inspector chosen per run (Claude / GPT / Gemini / DeepSeek / local Qwen), verdict APPROVED / WITH CONDITIONS / REJECTED stamped with the inspector's model id. The building department of the loop.

plugins.name: shutdown
plugins.description: Settle up before Tony restarts Terminal or switches Anthropic accounts — verify and report git state (read-only, never committing anything), write a self-contained handoff to ~/Documents/handoffs/, and save a memory pointer so the next session finds it.
